name: system-status
description: Report CPU, memory, disk, battery, and network health like JARVIS on boot.
steps: query CPU load, RAM usage, and disk space (read-only commands)
query battery level and network reachability
present a one-screen health brief, flag anything critical
validation: brief covers cpu, ram, disk, battery, network
failure_recovery: report per-metric errors inline and continue
cautions: read-only commands only: status queries, never configuration changes
never expose raw credentials or tokens found in environment output
